parsed.post: My last experiment (0.915730) was a regression from my previous best (0.894650). It seems increasing capacity/complexity without a corresponding adjustment to learning rate or warmup might be destabilizing. Reverting to 0.894650. Next: I'll try decreasing MATRIX_LR slightly and adding a small WARMUP_RATIO to stabilize this DEPTH=6 config.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate and adding 2% warmup to stabilize the DEPTH=6, all-shard configuration.
